judge: goseikei-judge (two independent model passes, keys withheld, per-pass option shuffle)
note: Blind two-pass certification of the authored 語形成 compound-completion rows, the shape of the 2018 N2V sample paper: a sentence prints a compound's fragment beside a （　） blank and four single kanji, exactly one of which completes the compound the sentence means. A row ships only when BOTH passes pick the frozen key AND both say fit: true; the verdict is valid only for the exact bytes judged, so every edit re-certifies. Round 1 judged the 23 drafted rows: 19 both-clean; 4 flagged (n2-g-002 two-answer among 農産物/鉱産物/林産物, n2-g-010 two-answer via 幼稚舎, n2-g-016 unnatural 昨日その前, n2-g-017 pass B picked 昨 for 昨来年). All four were rewritten and re-certified in round B on the new bytes: 002 and 010 both-clean, 016 failed again (the 去 distractor completes 去昨日, a real synonym of 一昨日 the bands do not carry), 017 failed again (pass B could not compose 再来年 at all). 016 was repaired once more (去→先, both passes clean in round C). 017 is burned: two rounds of judge failure on the same anchor means the item is not certifiable, and the row was replaced by n2-g-024 (再来月), both passes clean in round C. After round C the server's own leak rule (`hasStemLeak` in packages/item-engine/src/validation.ts) showed n2-g-013's passage printed 電車, which contains the key 車: the row would have been silently dropped at assembly rather than served. The sentence was rewritten (急な山道をゆっくり力強く登っていった) and re-certified on the new bytes in round D, both passes picking 車 with fit true. The mechanical gate must therefore also screen that the key kanji never appears in its own passage. Known limit: both passes are the author model's own family, so correlated error is not excluded and there is no human leg; the mechanical gate (scripts/check-goseikei.ts) carries the corpus-side screens, and the judges only catch the two-answer completions the corpus files do not list (幼稚舎, 去昨日, 昨来年 all absent from n5-n1 yet real to the judges). Transcripts: packages/japanese/.cache/judge/goseikei-n2-round1-A.md, -round1-B.md, -roundB-A.md, -roundB-B.md, -roundC-A.md, -roundC-B.md, -roundD-A.md, -roundD-B.md (a first round-B pass-A invocation returned two of four items and was discarded; the rerun is the recorded pass).
